title: Start a complete eight-player tournament
statement: The server MUST start a tournament only when its eight-player roster, seeds, source and generated plan satisfy the start preconditions.
expected: a complete draft and current version, an admin starts it, the state becomes active with the roster and plan locked
invalid: an incomplete or concurrently changed draft, start is attempted, the request fails without entering active

title: Display supplied participant names
statement: Clients MUST display the permitted tournament-specific participant names as inert text with duplicate-name disambiguation in selection contexts.
expected: two participants with the same name, their choices are rendered, each is distinguished by its short UUID suffix
invalid: a hostile supplied name, a permitted view renders it, it remains text and cannot execute

title: Create an empty public tournament draft
statement: An admin MUST be able to create a public empty draft with the specified metadata defaults and field bounds.
expected: only a valid name, an admin creates a draft, the public record contains zero players and Court 1
invalid: an empty name or unknown input property, creation is attempted, INVALID_INPUT leaves no draft

title: Replace the draft roster and seeds atomically
statement: The server MUST replace a draft roster atomically within the zero-to-eight distinct-player and unique optional seed bounds.
expected: a draft and a valid seed swap, an admin replaces the roster with publication attestations, both seed changes commit together
invalid: a ninth player, duplicate player/seed or active tournament, replacement is attempted, no roster change commits

title: Cancel an unfinished tournament
statement: Cancellation MUST cancel remaining play, preserve completed results and leave no champion under the defined state and open-order rules.
expected: an active tournament with completed and scheduled matches and no open orders, cancellation is submitted with reason, scheduled play is cancelled and completed results remain
invalid: an open beer order or completed tournament, cancellation is attempted, STATE_CONFLICT leaves the tournament unchanged

title: Archive completed or cancelled tournaments
statement: Archival MUST make eligible tournaments read-only and remove them from discovery while retaining their public direct link during retention.
expected: a completed tournament with no open orders, an admin archives it, list discovery omits it and direct read still succeeds
invalid: an active tournament, archival is attempted, STATE_CONFLICT preserves its state

title: Maintain explicit player identities
statement: Admins MUST create and select stable player UUID identities without merging or restricting duplicate display names.
expected: an existing name, an admin explicitly creates a second player with that name, a distinct identity is created
invalid: an erased player reference, roster assignment is attempted, the erased identity is not assignable

title: Correct a tournament name snapshot
statement: A participant-name correction MUST affect only the selected tournament snapshot and permitted states.
expected: one player assigned to two tournaments, an admin corrects one participation name, the other snapshot remains unchanged
invalid: an archived or cancelled tournament, a name correction is attempted, no snapshot change occurs

title: Edit tournament metadata
statement: Admins MUST edit only the metadata fields permitted in the current tournament state without changing stored instants or regenerating pairings.
expected: an active tournament, venue/time zone is changed with current version, stored match instants and competitors remain unchanged
invalid: an active tournament, ranking source or courts are changed, the request is rejected

title: Delete an eligible draft
statement: Admins MUST be able to delete only draft tournaments with no retained commerce references.
expected: an eligible draft, deletion commits, subsequent public read returns NOT_FOUND and sanitized audit remains
invalid: a draft with a retained sale or order, deletion is attempted, STATE_CONFLICT preserves it

title: Read the complete match plan
statement: Clients MUST show the complete seven-match plan with canonical rounds and future-winner placeholders.
expected: a generated draft with unplayed quarterfinals, the plan is read, four quarterfinals/two semifinals/final appear with feeder labels
invalid: no generated plan, the view is opened, it shows the explicit empty plan state without fabricated matches

title: Generate the fixed seeded bracket
statement: An admin MUST generate the fixed 1v8/4v5/3v6/2v7 singles knockout bracket from the approved source and complete relative seeds.
expected: a complete draft seeded1–8, generation commits, exactly seven correctly linked matches exist
invalid: an active tournament or incomplete seed permutation, generation is attempted, no bracket is replaced

title: Schedule a match without known conflicts
statement: Manual scheduling MUST enforce complete schedule fields, valid local instants and the defined court/player/feeder constraints.
expected: a scheduled match and available court/interval, an admin saves a complete schedule, its UTC instant and local display agree
invalid: a court overlap, nonexistent local time or partial schedule, saving is attempted, INVALID_INPUT preserves the former schedule

title: Read the tournament scoreboard
statement: Clients MUST show all match scores, status, participants/placeholders and outcome labels without substituting zero for absent data.
expected: a started match with no games, the scoreboard is read, it says In progress — no score yet
invalid: a failed initial read, the screen renders, it shows Unavailable/Retry without zero scores

title: Save an in-progress game/set score
statement: An admin MUST save validated in-progress set scores with version checks and no implicit match completion.
expected: an in-progress match and valid partial score, Save score commits, the score changes and the match remains in progress
invalid: a stale tournament version, score save is attempted, VERSION_CONFLICT preserves the stored score and client draft

title: Start an eligible match
statement: An admin MUST start only an eligible scheduled match with known competitors, completed feeders and no conflicting in-progress player or court.
expected: an active tournament and eligible scheduled match, start commits, actual start is recorded and state is in_progress
invalid: an incomplete feeder or busy player/court, start is attempted, no match enters in_progress

title: Validate best-of-three set scores
statement: The score validator MUST enforce the specified game, set, tie-break and match-winning invariants.
expected: valid sets 6–4 and 7–6 with tie-break7–5, validation runs, it derives the same winner for both sets and match
invalid: an extra set after two wins or inconsistent tie-break winner, validation runs, the score is rejected

title: Record a walkover or retirement
statement: An exceptional result MUST record the permitted unavailable player/outcome and advance the opponent without fabricated scores.
expected: an unstarted eligible match and one unavailable player, a walkover commits with reason, the opponent wins with empty sets
invalid: both players unavailable or retirement on an unstarted match, exception completion is attempted, no invented winner is stored

title: Complete and advance a normal result
statement: A normal completion MUST atomically store its validated result, advance the winner and complete the tournament when the final finishes.
expected: a final with valid winning sets, completion commits, final result, champion and completed tournament are visible together
invalid: an incomplete normal score or concurrent stale completion, completion is attempted, no partial advancement occurs

title: Correct a completed result safely
statement: A completed-result correction MUST apply the specified same-winner/changed-winner descendant guard and recompute dependent projections.
expected: a completed quarterfinal with all descendants scheduled, its winner is corrected, next-match competitor and statistics change once
invalid: a started descendant and changed winner, correction is attempted, DOWNSTREAM_STARTED preserves all results

title: Read world ranking snapshots
statement: Public clients MUST show the current world snapshot with source, as-of date, tie and stale/unranked states.
expected: a published world snapshot with tied positions, it is read, source/date/tied rows use defined ordering
invalid: no world snapshot, the view opens, it says No rankings published without computed ranks

title: Read local ranking snapshots
statement: Public clients MUST show the current local snapshot with configured local scope and defined stale/unranked states.
expected: a local snapshot older than 30 days, it is read, local scope label and Out of date appear while entries remain
invalid: a player absent from the snapshot, its requested ranking is shown, it says Unranked rather than zero

title: Replace a ranking snapshot atomically
statement: An admin MUST replace one complete world/local snapshot atomically using validated registered-player positions and source metadata.
expected: a valid replacement with equal positions for different players, it commits, both tied entries are visible together
invalid: a repeated player, future as-of date or stale version, replacement is attempted, the current snapshot remains unchanged

title: Derive current tournament statistics
statement: Tournament statistics MUST derive each participant’s played/wins/losses/percentage from current completed outcomes exactly once.
expected: one normal win and one retirement loss, statistics are read, played2 wins1 losses1 percentage50.0 appear
invalid: no completed results, statistics are read, counts are zero and percentage is unavailable

title: Maintain merchandise catalog records
statement: Admins MUST create/edit merchandise catalog fields under the specified name, price, currency and stock bounds without changing history.
expected: an item with prior sales, its name/price is changed, future sales use new values while prior snapshots remain
invalid: a fractional price or unsupported currency, catalog save is attempted, no item change occurs

title: Record one stock-backed merchandise sale
statement: A merchandise sale MUST atomically snapshot one item’s price/currency, record quantity and decrement available stock once.
expected: stock 5 and quantity 3, a sale commits, stock 2 and one immutable sale exist
invalid: two competing sales exceeding available stock, both are submitted, at most stock-supported sales commit and stock never becomes negative

title: Report retained merchandise sales
statement: Merchandise reports MUST sum retained sale quantities/totals in the selected tournament/time range separately by currency.
expected: EUR and USD sales in a range, the report is read, separate exact totals and item units appear
invalid: a reversed or greater-than 366-day explicit range, report read is attempted, INVALID_INPUT is returned without a misleading total

title: Retire merchandise from new sales
statement: Retiring a catalog item MUST prevent new sales while preserving referenced history.
expected: a referenced active item, it is marked inactive, history remains and a new sale is rejected
invalid: a direct API sale against an inactive item, it is attempted, no stock or sale change occurs

title: Adjust stock with an accountable delta
statement: A stock adjustment MUST apply one nonzero bounded delta with reason and stable operation reference.
expected: stock 5 and delta−2 with reason, adjustment is retried identically, resulting stock is3 with one adjustment
invalid: zero delta or resulting negative stock, adjustment is attempted, no stock change commits

title: Maintain menu items and retirement
statement: Admins MUST create/edit/retire menu items under the specified bounds while preserving existing order snapshots.
expected: an item in an open order, its price changes and it is retired, the order retains its old price and can complete
invalid: an inactive item, a new order is attempted, it is rejected without an order

title: Create a fixed beer-garden order
statement: An order MUST snapshot one-to-fifty distinct same-currency menu lines and a monotonic tournament display number atomically.
expected: valid current menu versions and distinct lines, order creation commits, one open order has immutable lines and exact total
invalid: mixed currencies, duplicate lines or stale item version, creation is attempted, no partial order exists

title: Resolve an order into one terminal outcome
statement: An open order MUST become completed with one sale or cancelled with none, with terminal replay and no-reopen rules enforced.
expected: an open order, completion is retried or races cancellation, exactly one terminal state and at most one sale result
invalid: a terminal order, the opposite terminal action is requested, STATE_CONFLICT preserves its state

title: Report completed beer-garden sales
statement: Beer-garden reports MUST total only completed-order sales in the selected range separately by currency.
expected: open/cancelled/completed orders, the report is read, only completed-sale values contribute
invalid: an invalid time range, report read is attempted, no misleading report is returned

title: Read the open order queue
statement: Admins MUST read open orders oldest-first with stable display number, fixed lines and totals.
expected: multiple open orders, the queue is read, created-time/UUID ordering and exact totals are displayed
invalid: no open orders, the queue is read, the explicit empty state appears without terminal orders

title: Reconcile stable mutation outcomes
statement: Every mutation MUST preserve actor/action/content-bound operation references and reconcile uncertain outcomes without repeating effects.
expected: a committed write with lost acknowledgement, the same command/reference is retried, the committed result is returned without another effect
invalid: the same reference with changed content or another actor, it is submitted/looked up, conflict or inaccessible outcome is returned without disclosure

title: Represent money without payment processing
statement: Money MUST use exact bounded integer minor units, currency-separated decimal-string totals and the explicit no-payment/no-reversal scope.
expected: EUR unit price1250 and quantity 3, a total is computed, it is3750 minor units and displays EUR37.50
invalid: a nonfinite/fractional minor-unit price or payment credential field, it is submitted, the input is rejected

title: Discover public tournaments by cursor
statement: Public discovery MUST apply the specified filtering, nonarchived selection and stable bounded cursor ordering.
expected: multiple nonarchived tournaments, pages are requested, newest-first/UUID ordering and the chosen filters are honored
invalid: an altered or filter-mismatched cursor, list read is attempted, MALFORMED_REQUEST is returned

title: Deliver platform parity
statement: Web, iOS and Android MUST support all granted launch workflows with the same domain contracts and supported platform floor.
expected: equivalent fixtures and permissions on all three clients, the same supported workflow is completed, its observable domain result agrees
invalid: an unsupported device or missing passkey capability, authentication is attempted, supported-device guidance appears without weaker fallback

title: Refresh views and preserve uncertainty safely
statement: Clients MUST apply the defined foreground polling, bounded retries, memory-only dirty forms and offline/stale/unknown-result states.
expected: a visible tournament screen and a committed score, healthy polling occurs, the update is visible within the specified seven-second target
invalid: a failed poll or lost write response, the client reacts, prior data/input is preserved with stale or unknown status and no new write reference

title: Meet the bounded launch capacity profile
statement: The deployed service MUST meet the specified sixty-minute capacity/latency/error/visibility profile before promotion.
expected: the published fixture and request distribution, the60-minute load run completes, all specified percentiles/error/visibility thresholds pass
invalid: oversized or abusive requests during the profile, limits are exercised, rejected work has no partial protected effects

title: Recover within defined loss and time targets
statement: Quarterly isolated restore verification MUST demonstrate RPO≤5min and RTO≤60min with privacy erasure replay before serving.
expected: a recent backup and erasure tombstones, an isolated restore is performed, recovery meets both targets with erased names absent
invalid: unavailable tombstones or failed integrity checks, restored service promotion is attempted, it remains isolated

title: Run bounded maintenance jobs
statement: Maintenance MUST run the defined expiry, retention and audit jobs with election, bounded batches, durable cursors and retry/alert behavior.
expected: two worker instances, scheduled maintenance becomes due, only the elected worker processes a batch and records progress
invalid: a dependency repeatedly fails, the job exhausts its three retries, it stops that attempt and alerts while later runs resume the durable cursor

title: Measure monthly service availability
statement: Operations MUST measure public/admin availability against99.5% monthly including planned downtime.
expected: a full month of health/synthetic transaction evidence, availability is calculated, planned and unplanned failures both count
invalid: both readiness checks fail for two minutes, monitoring evaluates them, the specified high-severity alert fires

title: Accessible complete launch workflows
statement: Every supported user workflow MUST satisfy the specified responsive, semantic, feedback and WCAG2.2AA/equivalent native accessibility outcomes.
expected: a supported workflow, keyboard and assistive-technology users complete it, names/roles/states, focus and feedback convey the same outcome
invalid: large text,320px width or a blocking validation error, the workflow is exercised, no essential control/content becomes inaccessible
